reviews.text: Kris was a knowledgeable and friendly salesman. We were able to get all of our answers regarding purchasing our Bullfrog spa. Communication was excellent throughout the process from buying it to installing it at the house.  Highly recommended Southern Leisure Spas!

Bought a Horus from there guys 7 years ago. 7 years later I had them service and professionally clean my hot tub. The service department was super nice and professional and then I can’t say enough good things about Chris (the spa tech they sent out). He was so knowledgeable and friendly and good at his job. Among the best experiences I’ve had of this kind with any product ever.  I’m really glad to see that 7 years later the business is still run very well and they are still supporting we custome

Kris Schweitzer deserves 10 stars!

We’re thoughtful shoppers who did our homework before heading out—on a rainy day with flood warnings, no less. Southern Leisure was our second stop, and after visiting four more places, we circled back. Why? Because of Kris.

Even while juggling multiple customers, Kris made sure we felt seen and supported. He went above and beyond, texting us helpful information while we were still out shopping.

When we returned, we were leaning toward a smaller round spa un

Had an awesome experience with Southern Leisure! Kris Schweitzer was incredible helping me pick a hot tub, learn how to use the chemicals and keep it in good condition etc. I always felt informed throughout the process, and know I got a great deal! I highly recommend Southern Leisure, and talk to Kris if you get the opportunity!

Great in store experience.  Kris helped us compare hot tub options with what was most important to us.  The buying process was easy and straightforward.   Our hot tub came in much earlier than expected!  Delivery and setup was quick and professional.  Our experience was great... would highly recommend!

We recently bought a new Bullfrog Spa from Southern Leisure Spas & Patio and couldn't have been happier with the whole process. From the beginning, the communication by Kris Schweitzer, at the Flower Mound store, was exceptional. Pricing negotiations were transparent and moved quickly. Kris swiftly addressed all our questions and kept us apprised on production status and delivery. The delivery crew did a great job as well; on-time, engaging, and professional. Prep, setup, and maintenance documen

I definitely recommend Southern Leisure Spa.  The whole experience of purchasing my spa was simply great. From keeping me informed about my order status to the free delivery and setup.  Kris Schweitzer took care of us through the entire process. I love my hot tub!

Kris was extremely knowledgeable, helpful, and patient as we navigated our different options.  Never did we feel pressured, not did we get a sense Kris only wanted to sell the more expensive options.  Fair, reasonable, and extremely professional!
Got a good deal at the spa sale. Nordic Jubilee SE model. Good selection. Good price. Quick delivery. No problems or issues. Now just need Fall to hurry up and get here.

Super easy purchase and delivery experience. Southern leisure not only provided a great deal on a new Bullfrog, delivered and removed my old hot tub, but they also provided me excellent referrals for some other contractors to renovate my patio and backyard space. The store manager was always extremely responsive and answered the many questions I asked quickly and thoroughly. Overall a great experience and I would highly recommend the Flower Mound location!!

I have purchased a hot tub and cold plunge from Southern Leisure in Flower Mound. Couldn’t be happier with their customer service before and after the purchase! Kris has been phenomenal with any and all questions and support!

What a great company, great products, and awesome service. I don’t think it can get much better than this minus the need for some digital document/ signature consolidation by leveraging newer technologies.
Purchased my Bullfrog AL8 from Siuthern Kesure and am very pleased and happy.  Great guidance, counsel, and service during deciding on what to buy, installation and after purchase.

I worked with Kris at Southern Leisure and he walked me through everything. Great information on a few things I didn’t know about which saved me some time and money. Highly recommend the folks at Southern Leisure! Thanks Kris!

Justin at Southern Leisure Spas & Patio was wonderful to work with! He went out of his way to explain all of the options available to me and also was so responsive on the back end for financing. I spent a long time looking for the right place to purchase my hot tub, and I am so thankful to Justin for his hard work!

Visiting with sales manager Kris put our minds at ease on our hot tub purchase. Kris knows his stuff and was wonderful to work with. After our purchase the delivery team was great and we couldn’t be happier with support provided by the service department technician Chris when we met with him. Overall Southern Leisure is a great company to work with!!

If you could 6 stars for the experience, I would.  I was originally thinking I was going to purchase a hot tub/spa from Costco.  The prices were good- but upon further research the reviews were pretty scary.  They also didn't come with installation, covers, etc.  If anything went wrong, well good luck.

I found Southern Leisure Spas & Patio while researching online.  I started to communicate with Austin Sifuentes, who was an absolute wealth of knowledge.  Austin sent me several options for spas

Our experience was top notch at with Kris. We did the majority of our transaction over text and he made it seamless.  We are excited to use our new spa and would recommend Southern Leisure Spas to anyone looking for one.
Great overall experience. Kris was very helpful in our process. He was as knowledgeable and answered all of our questions.

Store manager Kris was great on the front end believe we got a great tub and a great value.
Delivery and install crew were professional and very considerate during the tail end.
All around great experience!
